dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/11/Text/8] PRP-A reduced hopelessness and depressive symptoms (on the CDI) and tended to reduce anxiety symptoms relative to control. We found no added benefit of the PRP parent intervention. PRP-A was more beneficial to students who reported elevated levels of hopelessness at baseline.
